name: Thorium Plated Dagger
summary: A Thorium Plated Dagger is an enchanted weapon carried by Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers in the Cauldron. Velarok Windblade needs its thorium alloy for a sturdy shaft.

sections.title: Enchanted Thorium
sections.body: Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers in the Cauldron carry Thorium Plated Daggers made with enchanted thorium. Velarok Windblade seeks the sturdy alloy to reforge a shaft for the flawless flame.

faq.answer: Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers in the Cauldron carry Thorium Plated Daggers.

faq.q: Why does Velarok want the daggers?
faq.answer: Velarok Windblade can break down their enchanted thorium alloy and reforge a shaft.

faq.q: What is the dagger made of?
faq.answer: The dagger uses enchanted thorium, an extremely sturdy alloy.

faq.q: How many daggers does Velarok need?
faq.answer: Velarok Windblade needs eight Thorium Plated Daggers.
